info.name: FTS SQL
info.summary: Full text search over the database Nextcloud already runs
info.description: A full text search platform for the fulltextsearch framework that indexes into the database the Nextcloud instance already runs — PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB or SQLite — so nobody has to operate Elasticsearch to get full text search. Plain text is indexed as of Milestone 1; office formats and PDF arrive in later milestones, still with no external service and no external binary.
info.author: Néfix Estrada
